value.rationale: The dihedral symmetry constraint and Reuleaux triangle’s strict rotational-Minkowski area increase motivate the question whether monotonicity is general. A minimal two-harmonic smooth constant-width family yields an exact sharp threshold a^2=30b^2 and a qualitative transition from strict increase to two turning points, including an explicit smooth strictly convex counterexample. Such a parameter boundary is structurally motivated and not merely a tiny numerical improvement; no universal theorem for all constant-width bodies is claimed.
